authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full CDIAL pāḍḍa subsection 1 explicitly gives Prakrit paḍḍaya buffalo and pāḍī young buffalo, Gujarati pāḍɔ/pāḍī and Marathi pāḍā/pāḍī buffalo calf. The selected western paḍi/pāḍi/paḍo buffalo responses match this family with length and gender-ending variation retained. Preserve the generic survey gloss rather than changing it to calf. The dictionary proposes probable Dravidian origin; this is a link to the established IA lexical family, not a claim that the ultimate origin is settled. Distinguish the separately numbered pēḍḍa branch, and leave glottalized paṛʔi and o-vowel poḍ(i) for further review. Exact response: paḍi.
